visual.general_description: Composite of six grayscale MRI slices of the head and neck arranged in two rows of three, each labelled (a) to (f) below the image.
visual.detailed_description: Top row: (a) and (b) axial head slices and (c) a coronal head slice. Bottom row: (d) a coronal head slice, (e) an axial head slice and (f) a sagittal craniocervical slice. In (a) to (d) the cerebrospinal fluid spaces are dark, while (e) and (f) show bright cerebrospinal fluid. Small bright foci are visible in the white matter of several slices, and panel (f) shows the brainstem and cervical spinal cord. The letters in parentheses printed under each image are the only labels; panel (f) also carries a small white text label near its top edge and a gray rectangular patch in its upper right corner.
